title: Correct initial pressure
description: Essential: Student correctly calculates initial pressure of gas A as 100 cmHg using p₁ = p₀ + h + ΔL.

title: Isothermal process analysis
description: Important: Student applies Boyle's law to the isothermal compression of gas A to find Δh, using p₁V₁ = p₂V₂.

title: Final pressure calculation
description: Important: Student correctly determines p₂ = p₀ + h + Δh = 130 cmHg after mercury injection.

title: Volume change relationship
description: Important: Student recognizes that gas A's length decreases by ΔL/2 during mercury injection, giving V₂ = 10S.

title: Isochoric heating analysis
description: Important: Student applies Gay-Lussac's law to the heating at constant volume: p₂/T₂ = p₃/T₃.

title: Final pressure after heating
description: Essential: Student calculates p₃ = p₀ + h + Δh + ΔL = 136 cmHg when gas A returns to original length.

title: Unit consistency
description: Optional: Student maintains consistent units (cmHg, cm, K) throughout calculations.

title: Sign error in pressure
description: Pitfall: Student incorrectly adds/subtracts pressure terms, especially confusing ΔL direction.

title: Volume change misunderstanding
description: Pitfall: Student assumes wrong volume change during mercury injection (e.g., using ΔL instead of ΔL/2).
